OCR request with a document URL input

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\OcrRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\OcrRequest::from_json(json_encode(["document" => ["type" => "document_url", "url" => "https://example.com/doc.pdf"], "model" => "mistral/mistral-ocr-latest"]));
$result = LiterLlm::ocr($req);
var_dump($result);
```
